scripts.test:backend:unit: uv run --project backend pytest -c backend/pyproject.toml -m unit
scripts.test:backend:api: uv run --project backend pytest -c backend/pyproject.toml -m api
scripts.test:backend:integration: uv run --project backend pytest -c backend/pyproject.toml -m integration
scripts.test:editor:gate: pnpm run test:editor:check && pnpm run test:editor && pnpm run test:editor:build
scripts.test:runtime:gate: pnpm --filter web-runtime-vue check && pnpm --filter web-runtime-vue test && pnpm --filter web-runtime-vue build
scripts.test:render-contracts: uv run --project packages/render-contracts --extra dev pytest packages/render-contracts/tests
scripts.test:renderer: uv run --project renderer --extra dev pytest -c renderer/pyproject.toml renderer/tests
scripts.test:render-e2e: pnpm run test:e2e:prepare && playwright test --config tests/config/playwright.config.ts --project=smoke page-screenshot.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run test:e2e:prepare && pnpm run test:e2e:run
scripts.test:e2e:regression: pnpm run test:e2e:prepare && playwright test --config tests/config/playwright.config.ts --project=visual-edit --project=ai --project=runtime-heavy
scripts.test:e2e:all: pnpm run test:e2e:prepare && playwright test --config tests/config/playwright.config.ts --project=auth --project=smoke --project=visual-edit --project=ai --project=runtime-heavy
